market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL settlement (front-month) at ~$104. Requires ~10% rise in settlement price by end of June. Settlement-based test is harder than intraday. EIA forecast Brent peak ~$115 in Q2 with WTI typically lagging by $5-8. With Hormuz crisis ongoing, plausible. Moderate probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Settlement-only criterion makes intraday spikes irrelevant.
